resources.string: Pick a photo, check the masks the library found, change them if needed and save a new JPEG. Masks are opaque. The saved file has no metadata from the original. This app has no network permission and nothing is stored except the file you save.
Detection can miss faces, for example small, turned, covered or blurred ones. Check the result yourself.

The library ships no model. Choose an ONNX face-detection model file with the YuNet output layout (640 x 640 input). You are responsible for the model and its licence. The demo reads the file into memory and keeps no copy.
Check this model before you use it
SHA-256 of the chosen model file: %1$s
The model is loading. This cannot be cancelled once it has started.
Same size (long side up to 3,500 px)
Compare the SHA-256 with the one you expect, then choose Use this model.
Model loaded. You can choose a photo now.
Placing a new mask. Move and resize it with the buttons, then choose Place mask.
Too late to cancel. The masks were applied.

The photo shown is a preview. Masks are applied by the library from the original file when you save, so every change here starts again from the original pixels. Solid yellow boxes are detected faces; dashed outlines are the masks that will be applied.
Photo preview with box and mask outlines. %1$s. The masks are listed below.
Centre %1$d%% across and %2$d%% down, %3$d%% wide, %4$d%% high
There are no masks. If you save now, the photo is saved without any mask.
The saved file is a new JPEG built from the masked pixels, without metadata from the original.
For an app that does its own steps around FaceBlur: the photo is masked as a bitmap in memory and nothing is saved. Uses the model and the size choice from above.

Steps, in this order: 1. decode (orientation applied, long side at most 3,500 px); 2. mask the bitmap in place; 3. scale down to the size you chose, only after masking; 4. draw a watermark; 5. encode to JPEG once. The result below is read back from the encoded bytes. Nothing is saved and nothing is written to disk. No location is added.
Choose a photo to run the pipeline
